system.name: VideoKR
system.one_liner: A 315K-example training corpus over 145K new CC-licensed expert-domain videos for knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video understanding, built by skill-oriented QA synthesis.

content.variant_note: four grey-titled bands: a domain-share donut with colour-matched topic chips, a skill triangle beside a sample video as a film strip, and three QA cards
content.argues: VideoKR spans many professional knowledge domains, and every example is grounded in one of three core skills and, in the CoT subset, paired with a reasoning trace.
content.subject: Domain distribution donut, three-skill icon triangle, a collected video as a film strip, and three QA examples with reasoning.

lessons.what_to_learn: Build a dataset overview from titled bands: a domain donut with colour-matched topic chips, a skill key drawn as icons, one raw sample, and tinted example cards tagged with the same skill icons, so every example visibly links back to the key.
lessons.suits: benchmarks or corpora with a domain taxonomy, a skill taxonomy and per-example rationales, drawn as a tall single-column composite.

summary: VideoKR is a large training corpus for knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video understanding: 315K video reasoning examples over 145K newly collected, CC-licensed expert-domain videos, produced by a human-in-the-loop, skill-oriented pipeline. Figure 1 is a tall single-column dashboard of four grey-titled bands. A double-ring donut shows the domain split (Social Science 40.1%, Natural Science 37.9%, Engineering 18.8%, Healthcare 3.2%) with colour-matched topic lists on both sides; a triangle of three icons names the core skills (perception, knowledge, reasoning); a film strip with timestamped keyframes shows one collected chemistry video; and three tinted question, answer and reasoning cards carry skill icons that point back to the triangle.
summary_zh: VideoKR 是面向知识与推理密集型视频理解的训练语料。图为竖排四块：知识领域环形图配同色主题列表，感知/知识/推理三技能图标三角，带时间戳的视频胶片条，以及三张带技能图标的问答与推理示例卡。
notes: The prior order (contribution-mosaic first) was changed: the figure is a dataset dashboard, so scope-overview leads. The text layer holds hidden stale strings (R-SFT-260K, R-RL-170K, an older 9 pt version of the second QA card, a second 13 pt Core Skills) that are not visible in the print; the printed counts 201K and 114K are used. Icon counts follow the print (10 skill icons); the digest lists 12 small icon bitmaps. Mapping the three corner-icon sets to VIDR, KNOWVID and KNOWVIDR is inferred from the paragraph, since those abbreviations are not in the figure.
